prose: WP04 implements the public-facing edge layer end-to-end: the per-env ACM certificate (DNS-validated, wildcard SAN), the WAFv2 WebACL (3 AWS managed rule groups + 1 rate-based rule), the ALB access logs S3 bucket (prevent_destroy, KMS-encrypted, public-blocked, 30-day expiry), the AWS Load Balancer Controller helm release (Pod Identity, replicaCount=2, 3-subnet multi-AZ wiring), and the Ingress resource applied via kubernetes_manifest with FR-010 ALBC annotations. The chart learned an additive templates/ingress.yaml (gated on .Values.ingress.enabled) so a downstream chart install reproduces the same ALBC-ready manifest shape; the legacy nginx-style ingress block in values-prod.yaml was replaced. The Route53 alias record is intentionally not declared in this module (per WP04 T003/T009) because the ALB DNS is only knowable after the LBC reconciles — the wart is documented in main.tf with a sample commented resource and a recommendation to create the record in a follow-up apply.   21/21 tofu tests pass (5 edge + 6 cluster + 4 foundation + 6 identity); tofu validate clean for root + 4 modules; helm lint clean for prod+dev; tofu fmt clean. The 3 partials are the canonical AWS-API checks (apply / describe-acm / get-web-acl / helm list / plan-after-apply) deferred to first cluster create. Recommend APPROVE.

criteria.name: tofu apply -var-file=envs/prod.tfvars provisions: 1 ACM cert, 1 WAFv2 WebACL, 1 S3 bucket, 1 helm release (AWS LBC), 1 kubernetes_manifest (Ingress).
criteria.note: Config valid (tofu validate 5/5 success). Live tofu apply not run against AWS — state backend is empty by design. Resource shapes verified via the 5 passing edge-module tests.

criteria.name: aws acm describe-certificate --certificate-arn <arn> returns Status: ISSUED.
criteria.note: validation_method = "DNS" + aws_acm_certificate_validation.env_cert waits for DNS validation. acm_uses_dns_validation test asserts the validation method. AWS API not run in dev; will resolve on first tofu apply against a Route53-hosted parent zone.

criteria.name: aws wafv2 get-web-acl --id <id> --scope REGIONAL returns the 4 rules.
criteria.note: length(aws_wafv2_web_acl.env_waf.rule) == 4 statically enforced by waf_has_managed_and_rate_rules test (plan + assert against the live resource address). AWS API not run in dev.

criteria.name: helm list -n kube-system | grep aws-load-balancer-controller shows STATUS: deployed.
criteria.note: helm_release.aws_load_balancer_controller wired with Pod Identity (var.alb_controller_role_arn), replicaCount=2, subnets (3 public from foundation), clusterName, vpcId. alb_controller_uses_three_public_subnets test asserts the 3-subnet wiring. AWS apply deferred.

criteria.name: kubectl get ingress -n support-bot shows the ingress with ingressClassName: alb and the 4 ALBC annotations (if the chart is installed by a downstream feature).
criteria.note: kubernetes_manifest.env_ingress.manifest.metadata.annotations carries scheme/target-type/ssl-policy/listen-ports/healthcheck annotations + ingressClassName: alb. The same shape is mirrored in deploy/helm/support-bot/templates/ingress.yaml (gated on .Values.ingress.enabled). CI step T012 asserts the chart-rendered shape in both modes (enabled=true produces 1 Ingress; enabled=false produces 0).

criteria.name: helm template deploy/helm/support-bot --values values-prod.yaml | grep -E 'kind: Ingress' returns 1 Ingress.
criteria.note: Chart's templates/ingress.yaml renders cleanly under helm lint (prod+dev) and helm template. With ingress.enabled=true exactly 1 Ingress is rendered with ingressClassName: alb + the 4 FR-010 annotations; with ingress.enabled=false the template is fully omitted (verified manually and now enforced by CI step). values.yaml carries the new tofu-shaped ingress block; legacy nginx-style block in values-prod.yaml replaced with comment explaining the tofu ownership.

criteria.name: cd infra/modules/edge && tofu test runs all 4 run blocks; all assertions pass.
criteria.note: 5/5 pass: acm_cert_has_wildcard_san, acm_uses_dns_validation, waf_has_managed_and_rate_rules, alb_controller_uses_three_public_subnets, alb_access_logs_bucket_name_and_encryption. Used contains() against the SAN set (subject_alternative_names is set(string)), not indexed access.

criteria.name: tofu plan after apply reports No changes.
criteria.note: Idempotency enforced by deterministic resource addresses (per-env buckets, certificate names), lifecycle.prevent_destroy = true on the logs bucket, and stable WAF rule priorities. Plan-after-apply can't be exercised in dev (no AWS); will resolve on first tofu apply followed by re-plan.

criteria.name: Misfit Resolution: each misfit in misfits_addressed has a passing test
criteria.note: M2 chart/infra drift ALB half — FR-010 annotations pinned in tofu kubernetes_manifest AND chart templates/ingress.yaml, enforced by tofu test + chart CI step. M4 multi-AZ ALB — var.public_subnet_ids length=3 wired into the ALBC helm release, asserted by alb_controller_uses_three_public_subnets. M8 prevent_destroy — lifecycle.prevent_destroy=true on the ALB access logs bucket + versioning + sse + 30-day expiry + bucket policy granting s3:PutObject to the regional ELB log-delivery service principal.

criteria.name: Subsystem Boundary Respect: no undeclared cross-subsystem coupling
criteria.note: modules/edge consumes exactly the S1→S4 (foundation.vpc_id, public_subnet_ids, vpc_endpoint_security_group_id), S2→S4 (cluster.cluster_name, cluster_security_group_id), S3→S4 (identity.alb_controller_role_arn, identity.cmk_arn) contracts documented in plan.md. No undeclared imports of foundation/cluster/identity resource addresses; only module outputs are referenced. The chart side uses the same ingress shape under .Values.ingress so chart and tofu stay in sync (FR-010).

criteria.name: Contract Compliance: implementation matches plan.md inter-system contracts
criteria.note: 5 outputs (acm_cert_arn, wafv2_web_acl_arn, alb_access_logs_bucket, alb_access_logs_bucket_arn, ingress_name) match the S4 plan inter-system contract. ALB DNS outputs are intentionally omitted per WP04 T009 note (ALB is LBC-created, DNS only knowable after apply) — the gap is documented in modules/edge/main.tf as a commented sample resource with the recommended pattern.

criteria.name: No New Misfits: no new failure modes introduced without documenting them
criteria.note: 2 flagged ambiguities recorded in modules/edge/CONTEXT.md: 'Ingress' = Kubernetes object vs ALB resource; 'ALB Controller' vs 'AWS Load Balancer Controller'. Route53 alias race (LBC creates ALB asynchronously after Ingress apply) is a known gap documented in main.tf with a recommended follow-up pattern. No new misfits introduced.

criteria.name: Build Health -- language type-checker exits 0
criteria.note: tofu validate succeeds for root + modules/edge + modules/cluster + modules/foundation + modules/identity (5/5). tofu fmt -check -recursive exits 0. helm lint clean for prod + dev values.

dependency_notes: WP07 (docs-and-ci) declares WP04 in its dependencies. If WP04 changes were requested, WP07 would need to re-run implement after the WP04 fix lands on main. Since this review approves WP04, WP07 can proceed without re-running implement.
closing: APPROVE — WP04 implements S4 Edge & Traffic with passing unit tests, clean tofu validate/fmt, helm lint clean, and documented deferred AWS-API checks; safe to merge into main and unblock WP05 / WP07.
